summary: Verified deploy-drift detection end-to-end. Backend /api/worker-health: 401 without JWT, returns full shape with correct dashboard_known_types (7 types incl inventory_sync + accept_labels), missing_from_workers = full set when empty, stuck_pending_by_type correctly increments for pending>15min jobs whose type is unadvertised. Pytest: test_worker_health.py + test_inventory_actions.py + test_iteration10.py = 16/16 pass. Frontend WorkerDriftBanner: appears on /live-inventory, /auto-accept, /inventory-actions when no workers registered (contains update.sh copy-paste block); disappears on all 3 pages after seeding a healthy worker advertising all 7 types. Scraper files verified: install.sh line 35 uses `cp -v *.py *.sh`, update.sh present and well-formed, label_worker.py _publish_capabilities upserts into worker_capabilities on startup.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in interval selector (pre-existing Emergent instrumentation artifact, unrelated to this feature)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is 3730 lines — should be split into routers per domain for maintainability.
WorkerDriftBanner has no loading/error UI states — silent catch. Acceptable for optional diagnostic banner but worth logging in dev.
seed_data_creation: Temporary worker_capabilities docs (test-healthy, test-old-worker) and a fake stuck job — all cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: worker_capabilities collection is left EMPTY in preview (matches reality of preview env with 0 scraper workers). Banner logic is fully working. Real deploy fix is up to end user running update.sh on EC2.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was verifying the fix, not diagnosing a new bug. Original RCA (deploy-drift because install.sh copied only 4 hardcoded filenames) is addressed by install.sh glob copy + new update.sh + worker_capabilities publish + drift banner.
